sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commission Against Corruption surveyed staff at the state’s three public universities about perceived corruption and other improper conduct.
sentences.support: Staff employed at the University of Adelaide, University of South Australia and Flinders University were invited to participate

sentences.text: The voluntary survey received 2,527 responses and focused on research integrity, records management and outside professional activities.
sentences.support: The current survey focuses on research integrity, records management and outside professional activities.

sentences.text: The Commission reported that recruitment favouritism and misuse of authority remained the largest perceived corruption risks, while reported access to adequate training had declined.
sentences.support: Nepotism and favouritism in recruitment and misuse of authority continue to be seen as the largest corruption risks.

sentences.text: The Commission urged universities to improve integrity messaging, support staff reporting and explain reporting duties and protections.
sentences.support: All three universities would do well to invest in their messaging on integrity standards and their expectations around reporting.

findings.quote: The proportion of respondents who have received sufficient training on corruption risks has decreased from 2020 to 2023.

notes: No separate executive summary or overview or numbered recommendations. Survey responses are perceptions and reported experiences, not findings that particular misconduct occurred.
